title: FEU Theater Guild stages Filipino reimagining of ‘Mother Sauvage’ in ‘MORYON’
summary: “MORYON” is a Filipino reimagining of Guy de Maupassant’s “Mother Sauvage” that examines faith, grief, justice, and survival during the Japanese Occupation of Marinduque.
